lines.text: Abimelech and Phicol ask Abraham to swear not to deal falsely with them, and Abraham says, "I swear it."
Abraham complains about a seized well, and Abimelech says he did not know and had not heard until today.
Abraham gives Abimelech sheep and goats, they make a covenant, and Abraham sets apart seven ewe lambs.
Abraham says the seven ewe lambs are his witness that he dug the well, so the place is called Bethel.
Abimelech and Phicol return to the land of the Philistines, and Abraham plants a tamarisk tree and calls on the LORD.
